title: The divergence of a C¹ field compactly supported in the open unit cube integrates to zero over the cube
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, Q₁ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} ⊆ Euclid n (Lebesgue measure). If g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ is C¹, has compact support and tsupport g ⊆ Q₁, then ∫_{Q₁} div g = 0, where div g(y) := trace Dg(y) (LinearMap.trace of fderiv).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) = 0
